title: Late-Booked Ground Charges in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
**Rule.** A self-pay ground shipping charge of the PAP Supply Replenishment Program that is booked late is reduced:

- to **40 percent** of the fee when it is booked 31 or more days after the shipment went out;
- to **60 percent** of the fee when it is booked 15 to 30 days after.

A charge booked 14 days or fewer after the shipment went out is not reduced. The reduced charge is rounded to the cent half up.

## Counting

Calendar days from the shipment's ship date to the day the charge is booked.

| Days from ship date to booking | Share of the fee kept |
|---|---|
| 0 to 14 | not reduced |
| 15 to 30 | 60 percent |
| 31 or more | 40 percent |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, a fee of 6.95, shipment on 1 March)

- Booked 15 March (14 days): not reduced, 6.95.
- Booked 16 March (15 days): 60 percent of 6.95 is 4.17.
- Booked 31 March (30 days): 4.17.
- Booked 1 April (31 days): 40 percent of 6.95 is 2.78.
